summary: PRIOR shows well-aerated, clear bilateral lungs; CURRENT shows new diffuse perihilar and bibasilar haziness.

findings.rationale: PRIOR lungs are dark/well-aerated with sharp costophrenic angles and distinct vessels; CURRENT shows hazier perihilar markings and less distinct bibasilar angles. Caveat: CURRENT is a lower lung-volume/less inspired film with fewer visible ribs, which can artifactually increase apparent haziness and vascular crowding.
